test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

APJ Abdul Kalam was born in a middle class family. He was a short boy ________ ordinary looks.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'with rather'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct preposition to use after "**boy**" is "**with**" as it is often used to indicate a particular feature or quality that someone or something has.
 
• The word '**rather**' is used to make a statement or opinion stronger, especially one that is critical. It is appropriately fitting in this context as it suggests that APJ Abdul Kalam's looks were not extraordinary or noticeable, but ordinary.
 
• Option 1 ‘**with either**’ and Option 4 ‘**neither**’ are not grammatically correct and don’t make sense in the given context.
 
• Option 2 ‘**with as**’ is ungrammatical in this context; '**as**' is generally used for making comparisons, not describing attributes, which is the case in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** Option 3.**

**Correct Sentence:* ****APJ Abdul Kalam was born in a middle class family. He was a short boy **with rather** ordinary looks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• APJ Abdul Kalam, also known as the '**Missile Man of India**,' rose from humble beginnings to become the President of India and a globally respected scientist, proving that ordinary looks have no bearing on extraordinary achievements.
 
• '**Rather**' is a flexible word in English and can be used for emphasis, as in this context, or could mean '**to a certain extent**' or '**somewhat**.'
